title: Add a policy reward viewer for evaluated rollouts
summary: locomotion.reward_viewer writes a self-contained HTML page that plays each evaluation's rollout video, or a top-down footprint view when none exists, in sync with the per-control reward, its motionless counterfactual, the reward components, commanded versus achieved velocity and a foot-contact gait diagram. The series come from locomotion.reward_scorer, so the page shows exactly what the scorer computes. Linked timelines let several policies play side by side.
next: Review candidate rewards against the tripod baseline and the paired PPO rollouts in the viewer before proposing a native training comparison.
reason: An offline visualization tool and its tests change no measured result, roadmap marker, gate or training reward.
